_comment: Model configuration for Episodic. This file defines available models, their types, and parameters.
_pricing_note: Optional pricing can be added to any model. Format: {"input": 3.0, "output": 15.0, "unit": "per_1m_tokens", "last_updated": "YYYY-MM-DD"}

models.name: gpt-4o-mini
models.creator: OpenAI
models.description: OpenAI's efficient small model optimized for fast, cost-effective tasks. GPT-4o Mini delivers impressive quality for its size at a fraction of the cost of larger models. Ideal for high-volume applications where speed and cost matter more than maximum capability.

models.name: gpt-4o
models.creator: OpenAI
models.description: OpenAI's natively multimodal flagship model. Accepts text and images, produces text. Features 320ms average audio response time for natural conversation. Excels at spatial reasoning, chart analysis, and connecting visual with written content. Recent upgrades improved instruction following, problem solving, and conversational flow.
weaknesses: Superseded by GPT-5 for complex tasks

models.name: o3
models.creator: OpenAI
models.description: OpenAI's most advanced reasoning model. First o-series to 'think with images' - integrates visual information directly into reasoning chains. Can agentically use all ChatGPT tools (web search, Python, image generation). Makes 20% fewer major errors than o1 on difficult real-world tasks. Built with 10x the compute of o1.

models.name: o4-mini
models.creator: OpenAI
models.description: Best-performing benchmarked model on AIME 2024/2025 math competitions. Achieves 93.4% on AIME 2024, 99.5% with Python tools. Remarkable performance for its size and cost - 10x cheaper than o3. Features visual reasoning ('thinks with images') and 200K context with 100K output tokens.
weaknesses: Slightly below o3 on PhD-level science

models.name: gpt-5
models.creator: OpenAI
models.description: OpenAI's breakthrough model. 94.6% on AIME 2025 (math), 74.9% SWE-bench (coding), 88% Aider Polyglot. With web search, 45% fewer factual errors than GPT-4o; with thinking, 80% fewer than o3. Produces high-quality code, generates front-end UI with minimal prompting, and tackles complex tasks end-to-end.

models.name: gpt-5.3-codex

pricing._note: Estimated from GPT-5.2-Codex pricing; official API pricing not yet published

models.creator: OpenAI
models.description: OpenAI's most capable coding model. 25% faster than GPT-5.2-Codex. 77.3% Terminal-Bench 2.0, 64.7% OSWorld, 81.4% SWE-Lancer IC Diamond. First OpenAI model rated 'High capability' for cybersecurity. Agentic multi-file coding with interactive steering, terminal interactions, and self-directed testing. API access coming soon.

models.name: gpt-5.2
models.creator: OpenAI
models.description: OpenAI's response to Gemini 3. Three variants: Instant (fast everyday), Thinking (deep work, 80% SWE-bench), Pro (most trustworthy). 93.2% GPQA Diamond (PhD-level), 40.3% FrontierMath SOTA. 38% fewer errors than predecessor. Exceptional at spreadsheets, presentations, complex UI, and multi-step projects.
weaknesses: May be overkill for simple tasks

models.name: claude-opus-4-6
models.creator: Anthropic
models.description: Anthropic's most capable model. 128K max output (doubled from 4.5). Adaptive thinking replaces extended thinking with effort levels (low/medium/high/max). 68.8% ARC-AGI-2 (up from 37.6%), 65.4% Terminal-Bench 2.0, 72.7% OSWorld. 1M context available in beta. Compaction API for effectively infinite conversations.

models.name: claude-opus-4-5-20251101
models.creator: Anthropic
models.description: Previous Opus generation with effort parameter for reasoning depth control. Step-change improvements over Opus 4.1 in reasoning, coding, and problem-solving. Priced at 1/3 of Opus 4.1. Superseded by Opus 4.6 which doubles max output to 128K and adds adaptive thinking.

models.name: claude-opus-4-1-20250805
models.creator: Anthropic
models.description: Previous generation Opus, maintained for backwards compatibility. Superseded by Opus 4.5 which offers 3x better value at $5/$25 vs $15/$75 per million tokens. Use Opus 4.5 for new projects.

models.name: claude-sonnet-4-20250522
models.creator: Anthropic
models.description: Excellent balance of capability and cost. Context awareness feature for maintaining workflow momentum. Concise, direct communication style with fact-based progress updates. May skip verbose summaries after tool calls.

models.name: claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929
models.creator: Anthropic
models.description: Anthropic's best for complex agents and coding. 77.2% SWE-bench Verified. Available with 200K standard or 1M beta context window. Highest intelligence across most tasks at the Sonnet price point. Recommended for most general-purpose applications.
weaknesses: Less capable than Opus for hardest tasks

models.name: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001
models.creator: Anthropic
models.description: Anthropic's fastest model with near-frontier performance. First Haiku with extended thinking, computer use, and context awareness. 73.3% SWE-bench Verified - remarkably close to larger models. 64K output tokens. Best for speed and cost-sensitive multi-agent systems.

models.name: gemini-2.5-pro
models.creator: Google
models.description: Google's most advanced thinking model. 18.8% on Humanity's Last Exam (SOTA). 63.8% SWE-bench with custom agent. 1M context now, 2M coming soon. Features Deep Think mode for complex math/coding, thought summaries for debugging, and native audio output. Most secure Gemini with enhanced prompt injection protection.
strengths: Deep Think mode for hard problems
weaknesses: Higher latency in Deep Think mode

models.name: gemini-2.5-flash
models.creator: Google
models.description: Google's first Flash with thinking capabilities. Best price-performance model. 20-30% more efficient token usage than predecessor. Controllable thinking budget - choose when and how much the model reasons. 1M context with 65K output tokens. Hybrid reasoning maintains low latency while enabling deep analysis when needed.

models.name: gemini-2.5-flash-lite
models.creator: Google
models.description: Google's ultra-efficient model at $0.10/$0.40 per million tokens - 3x cheaper than Flash. Maintains 1M context window. Optimized for high-volume, cost-sensitive applications where speed matters more than maximum capability. Good for classification, extraction, and simple generation tasks.

models.name: llama3.1
models.creator: Meta
models.description: Meta's Llama 3.1 via Ollama. Available in 8B, 70B, and 405B variants. Strong multilingual support (8 languages). 128K context window. Apache 2.0 license allows commercial use. Superseded by 3.2/3.3 but still widely deployed.

models.name: llama3.2
models.creator: Meta
models.description: Meta's Llama 3.2 via Ollama. First Llama with vision capabilities (11B and 90B variants). Lightweight 1B and 3B text models run on edge devices. 128K context. Better instruction following and tool use than 3.1.

models.name: llama3.3
models.creator: Meta
models.description: Meta's most capable Llama 3 via Ollama. 70B model with 128K context. Matches Llama 3.1 405B performance at fraction of compute. Enhanced reasoning, math, and instruction following. Last Llama 3 before Llama 4 architecture shift.

models.name: mistral:instruct
models.creator: Mistral AI
models.description: Instruction-tuned variant of Mistral 7B for Ollama. Optimized for following specific instructions rather than open conversation. Good for task-oriented workflows.

models.name: mistral-nemo
models.creator: Mistral AI / NVIDIA
models.description: Mistral AI + NVIDIA collaboration. 128K context window - state-of-the-art for 12B size. New Tekken tokenizer: 30% more efficient on code, 2-3x better on Korean/Arabic. Trained with quantization awareness - FP8 inference without quality loss. Drop-in replacement for Mistral 7B with much better reasoning.

models.name: mistral-nemo:instruct
models.creator: Mistral AI / NVIDIA
models.description: Instruction-tuned Mistral Nemo 12B. Strong function calling for tool use and automated workflows. 128K context enables processing long documents and codebases. 83.5% HellaSwag, 68% MMLU. Optimized for NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM.

models.name: phi4
models.creator: Microsoft
models.description: Microsoft's 14B reasoning powerhouse. Outperforms comparable models on MATH, GPQA, and HumanEval due to high-quality synthetic training data. Phi-4-reasoning variants achieve 82.5% AIME 2025, approaching DeepSeek R1 70B performance. Multimodal variant supports vision+audio.

models.name: llama4-scout
models.creator: Meta
models.description: Meta's efficient Llama 4 with 10M token context - industry leading. 17B active params via 16-expert MoE architecture. Fits single H100 GPU. Natively multimodal (text + images). Beats Gemma 3, Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite on most benchmarks. Trained on 40T tokens across 200 languages.

models.name: deepseek-r1
models.creator: DeepSeek
models.description: Open-source reasoning model matching OpenAI o1. 79.8% AIME, 97.3% MATH-500, 2029 Codeforces ELO. Trained via pure RL without human reasoning labels - emergent chain-of-thought in <think></think> tags. Distilled variants (7B-70B) available. Apache 2.0 license.

reasoning.note: Always reasons in <think> tags; cannot be disabled without custom template

models.name: deepseek-v3.1
models.creator: DeepSeek
models.description: DeepSeek's hybrid V3.1 combines V3 and R1 capabilities in one model. Features switchable thinking/non-thinking modes - use chain-of-thought reasoning for complex tasks or direct answers for speed. Excels at tool use, agentic workflows, and multi-step reasoning with 43% improvement over previous versions and 38% fewer hallucinations.
strengths: Superior tool use and agentic capabilities

models.name: nemotron-3-nano
models.creator: NVIDIA
models.description: NVIDIA's most efficient open model for agentic AI. Features configurable reasoning - enable chain-of-thought for complex problems or disable for faster direct answers. Unique hybrid Mamba-2/MoE architecture delivers 4x higher throughput than previous generation with 60% fewer reasoning tokens. Supports granular reasoning budget control.

models.name: qwen3-coder
models.creator: Alibaba
models.description: Alibaba's most agentic code model. Achieved 69.6% on SWE-Bench Verified - production-ready code generation. Features hybrid thinking mode that auto-detects task complexity. Supports 119 programming languages with 256K native context (1M with extrapolation). Excels at multi-turn agentic coding with planning, tool use, and iterative refinement.

reasoning.note: Ollama wraps native /think tags with API parameter

models.name: qwen3
models.creator: Alibaba
models.description: Alibaba's Qwen 3 via Ollama. Features hybrid thinking mode - use /think for chain-of-thought reasoning or /no_think for direct answers. Strong multilingual support (119 languages). Available in multiple sizes. Excels at reasoning, coding, and instruction following.

reasoning.note: Ollama wraps native /think tags with API parameter

models.name: qwen2.5
models.creator: Alibaba
models.description: Alibaba's flagship open model. 128K context window. Available 0.5B to 72B. 29+ languages including CJK, Arabic, Vietnamese. Strong coding (multiple programming languages) and math. Apache 2.0 license. Basis for Qwen 3 Coder and many fine-tunes.

models.name: qwen2.5:7b
models.creator: Alibaba
models.description: Qwen 2.5 7B - sweet spot for consumer hardware. 128K context. Outperforms Llama 3 8B and Mistral 7B on most benchmarks. Good balance of speed, quality, and resource usage. Runs well on 16GB+ RAM.

models.name: qwen2.5:14b
models.creator: Alibaba
models.description: Qwen 2.5 14B - significant capability jump from 7B. 128K context. Better reasoning and instruction following. Approaches larger model performance on many tasks. Good choice when 7B isn't quite enough.

models.name: qwen2.5:32b
models.creator: Alibaba
models.description: Qwen 2.5 32B - most capable dense Qwen 2.5. 128K context. Competitive with Llama 3.1 70B on many benchmarks at half the parameters. Excellent for complex reasoning, coding, and multilingual tasks.

models.name: gemma2
models.creator: Google
models.description: Google's open model with Gemini-derived architecture. Knowledge distillation from larger models gives impressive quality for size. Optimized for inference efficiency. Available in 2B, 9B, 27B. Great for on-device and edge deployment.

models.name: gemma2:2b
models.creator: Google
models.description: Gemma 2 2B - ultra-lightweight for edge/mobile. Runs on phones, Raspberry Pi, and minimal hardware. Remarkably capable for 2B through knowledge distillation. Good for classification, simple generation, and embedded use.

models.name: gemma2:9b
models.creator: Google
models.description: Gemma 2 9B - best quality/efficiency for consumer GPUs. Fits comfortably in 16GB VRAM. Strong instruction following and safety alignment. Good general-purpose choice for local deployment.

models.name: codellama
models.creator: Meta
models.description: Meta's code-specialized Llama 2 variant. 100K context for repository-scale understanding. Supports code infilling (fill-in-the-middle). Available 7B-70B with Python-specialized variant. Superseded by newer models but still widely used.

models.name: starcoder2
models.creator: BigCode
models.description: BigCode consortium's code model trained on The Stack v2 - 600+ programming languages from permissively licensed sources only. Ethically trained, IP-safe for commercial use. 15B variant strong on HumanEval and MBPP benchmarks.

models.name: deepseek-coder
models.creator: DeepSeek
models.description: DeepSeek's first code model. Trained from scratch on 2T tokens (87% code, 13% natural language). Fill-in-the-middle and repository-level completion. Superseded by DeepSeek-Coder-V2 and DeepSeek R1 but efficient for basic coding tasks.

models.name: openrouter/anthropic/claude-opus-4.1
models.creator: Anthropic
models.description: Claude Opus 4.1 via OpenRouter. Benefits: unified billing across providers, automatic failover, usage analytics. Note: Opus 4.1 is legacy - consider Opus 4.5 for better value ($5 vs $15 input).

models.name: openrouter/google/gemini-2.5-pro
models.creator: Google
models.description: Gemini 2.5 Pro via OpenRouter. Access Google's 2M context model without GCP setup. OpenRouter handles auth, provides usage tracking. Same Deep Think and thought summary capabilities.

models.name: openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-r1
models.creator: DeepSeek
models.description: DeepSeek R1 via OpenRouter. Access o1-matching reasoning without Chinese API setup. 79.8% AIME, visible chain-of-thought in <think> tags. Very competitive pricing through OpenRouter.

models.name: openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-chat-v3
models.creator: DeepSeek
models.description: DeepSeek V3 chat via OpenRouter. 671B params (37B active), MoE architecture. Strong general-purpose performance rivaling GPT-4 at fraction of cost. Easy access without direct DeepSeek account.

models.name: openrouter/meta-llama/llama-4-scout:free
models.creator: Meta
models.description: Llama 4 Scout FREE via OpenRouter. 10M context window, 17B active params, native multimodal. Zero cost tier for testing and low-volume use. Great for evaluating Llama 4 before committing.

models.name: openrouter/meta-llama/llama-4-maverick:free
models.creator: Meta
models.description: Llama 4 Maverick FREE via OpenRouter. 400B total params via 128-expert MoE. Beats GPT-4o on many benchmarks. Free tier for testing - remarkable value for zero cost.

models.name: openrouter/meta-llama/llama-3.1-70b-instruct
models.creator: Meta
models.description: Llama 3.1 70B Instruct via OpenRouter. 128K context, strong instruction following. Well-tested, stable model. Good choice when you need reliable 70B performance without Llama 4's newer architecture.

models.name: openrouter/meta-llama/llama-3.1-405b-instruct
models.creator: Meta
models.description: Llama 3.1 405B - largest open-weight dense model. Near GPT-4 performance without running massive infrastructure. OpenRouter pools capacity across providers. 128K context.

models.name: openrouter/meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct
models.creator: Meta
models.description: Llama 3.3 70B via OpenRouter - matches 405B performance at fraction of cost. 128K context. Enhanced math/reasoning over 3.1. Best Llama 3 value through OpenRouter's pooled capacity.

models.name: openrouter/mistralai/mistral-nemo
models.creator: Mistral AI / NVIDIA
models.description: Mistral Nemo 12B via OpenRouter. NVIDIA collaboration, 128K context, Tekken tokenizer (30% more efficient). Fits single GPU. Good mid-tier option through OpenRouter.

models.name: openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k2
models.creator: Moonshot AI
models.description: Moonshot AI's Kimi K2 - 1 trillion total params with 32B active (MoE). Strong agentic capabilities and tool use. 128K context. Competitive with Claude/GPT on many tasks at lower cost.

models.name: openrouter/mistralai/mixtral-8x7b-instruct
models.creator: Mistral AI
models.description: Mistral's pioneering MoE model - 8 experts, 12B active params. 32K context. Matches Llama 2 70B at fraction of compute. First widely-adopted open MoE. Apache 2.0 license.

models.name: openrouter/mistralai/mistral-large-2
models.creator: Mistral AI
models.description: Mistral's flagship 123B model via OpenRouter. Strong multilingual (European focus), 128K context, function calling. Competes with GPT-4/Claude. European AI sovereignty option.

models.name: openrouter/qwen/qwen-2.5-72b-instruct
models.creator: Alibaba
models.description: Qwen 2.5 72B via OpenRouter - largest dense Qwen 2.5. 128K context, 29+ languages. Rivals Llama 3.1 70B while often cheaper through OpenRouter's pricing.

models.name: openrouter/qwen/qwen-2.5-coder-32b-instruct
models.creator: Alibaba
models.description: Qwen 2.5 Coder 32B via OpenRouter. Code-specialized with 128K context for repo-scale understanding. Strong HumanEval/MBPP scores. Superseded by Qwen3-Coder but still capable.

models.name: openrouter/google/gemma-2-27b-it
models.creator: Google
models.description: Gemma 2 27B via OpenRouter - largest Gemma 2. Knowledge distillation from Gemini gives impressive quality. 8K context (smaller than competitors). Strong safety alignment. Good for when you want Google quality without GCP.

models.name: openrouter/x-ai/grok-2
models.creator: xAI
models.description: xAI's Grok-2 via OpenRouter. Real-time X (Twitter) data access. 128K context. Known for less filtered, more direct responses. Competitive with GPT-4 on benchmarks. Access without X Premium subscription.

models.name: huggingface/meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
models.creator: Meta
models.description: Llama 3.1 8B via HuggingFace Inference API - free tier available. 128K context. Good for testing and prototyping without API keys or local hardware. Rate limited but sufficient for development.

models.name: huggingface/meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct
models.creator: Meta
models.description: Llama 3.2 3B via HuggingFace - smallest Llama 3.x, designed for edge/mobile. Free inference API for testing. 128K context despite tiny size. Surprisingly capable for 3B through improved training.

models.name: huggingface/meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct
models.creator: Meta
models.description: Llama 3.3 70B via HuggingFace - matches 405B performance at 70B. Free inference API. 128K context. Best Llama 3 quality/compute ratio. Rate limited but good for evaluation and low-volume use.

models.name: huggingface/meta-llama/Llama-4-Scout
models.creator: Meta
models.description: Llama 4 Scout via HuggingFace - 10M context, 17B active params via MoE. Free inference tier for testing latest Llama. Native multimodal. Great for evaluating Llama 4 architecture.

models.name: huggingface/meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick
models.creator: Meta
models.description: Llama 4 Maverick via HuggingFace - 400B total via 128 experts, beats GPT-4o on benchmarks. 1M context. Free inference for testing Meta's flagship. May have queues during high demand.

models.name: huggingface/mistralai/Mistral-Small-3.1
models.creator: Mistral AI
models.description: Mistral Small 3.1 via HuggingFace - 7B with 32K context. Free inference tier. Apache 2.0 license. Good balance of speed and capability for the free tier.

models.name: huggingface/mistralai/Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct-v0.1
models.creator: Mistral AI
models.description: Mixtral 8x7B via HuggingFace - pioneering open MoE. 8 experts, 12B active params. Matches Llama 2 70B at fraction of compute. 32K context. Apache 2.0. Free inference tier for testing.

models.name: huggingface/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-0528
models.creator: DeepSeek
models.description: DeepSeek R1 (May update) via HuggingFace. o1-matching reasoning, 79.8% AIME. Free inference for testing chain-of-thought reasoning. Visible thinking in <think> tags. Apache 2.0.

models.name: huggingface/Qwen/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct
models.creator: Alibaba
models.description: Qwen 2.5 72B via HuggingFace - largest dense Qwen 2.5. 128K context, 29+ languages. Rivals Llama 3.1 70B. Free inference tier. Apache 2.0 license.

models.name: huggingface/google/gemma-2-27b-it
models.creator: Google
models.description: Gemma 2 27B via HuggingFace - largest Gemma 2. Gemini-distilled quality. 8K context (smaller than competitors). Strong safety alignment. Free inference tier.

models.name: huggingface/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3
models.creator: DeepSeek
models.description: DeepSeek V3 via HuggingFace - 671B MoE, GPT-4 class performance. 128K context. Free inference for testing. Excellent coding and reasoning. Superseded by V3.1 but still very capable.

models.name: huggingface/bigcode/starcoder2-15b
models.creator: BigCode
models.description: StarCoder 2 15B via HuggingFace - trained on The Stack v2 (permissive licenses only). 600+ programming languages. IP-safe for commercial use. Free inference for code completion.

models.name: huggingface/meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B
models.creator: Meta
models.description: Llama 3.3 70B base (pre-trained, not instruction-tuned) via HuggingFace. 128K context. Use for fine-tuning or when you need raw model behavior. Apache 2.0 license.

models.name: huggingface/mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.3
models.creator: Mistral AI
models.description: Mistral's 7B v0.3 base model via HuggingFace. The raw pre-trained model with excellent efficiency, suitable for fine-tuning.

models.name: topic-boundary-distilbert
models.description: Fine-tuned DistilBERT for topic boundary detection using (4,2) window configuration.

type_indicators._note: When model has 'reasoning' field, append R to indicator: [CI] -> [CIR], [I] -> [I R]
